args.function: Resolve the observed incompatibility between root-planting-trial and a genuinely prepared surface. Provide a bounded placement operation that can distinguish the nominated non-solid prepared surface from an actual occupied obstacle, examining feasibility before committing any root.
args.conditions: At tick 33, examination of 9.25,12.9 found coverMass 0 and residueMass 0 but reported not currently eligible: choose an actually unoccupied small patch. Surface surface-21-lin-113 exists there; conserved residue is at residue-deposit-30-lin-175, centered 9.65,12.9. Do not assume either object is the sole cause. Require real clearance and reachable geometry.
args.inputs: Candidate prepared-surface surface-21-lin-113 and, only after feasible placement is established, one actually unspoiled owned root from item-3-lin-12. Preserve remaining roots and existing residue deposits.
args.costs: Method and cost are unknown. Specify bounded labor, material reservation, interruption, resume and cancellation contracts before use. No free clearing, material creation or silent restoration.
args.effects: Enable a physical placement trial only if actual conditions permit, retaining exact root accounting and persistent observations. Otherwise report the specific incompatibility without modifying the site. Do not grant growth, harvest, fertility, reward or personal mastery.

candidates.function: Examine one nominated radius-0.2 footprint, then attempt at most two rounds of manual loose-cover displacement, conserving debris inside the original boundary.
candidates.costs: Fresh start: one round and 0.5 energy for feasibility. Up to two additional work rounds cost one energy each. Radius is fixed at 0.2; x/y bind the job and cannot be substituted. No tool, root, water, food or inventory material is given or consumed.
candidates.effects: Supports explicitly modeled loose forest-floor cover only. Each supported footprint begins with finite 0.04 cover mass units, with hand capacity 0.02 per work round. All displaced matter remains non-food non-harvestable residue inside the boundary. Repeated attempts reuse actual remaining cover/residues, never reset quantities. Partial changes persist; cancel/death closes only the work lock, without restoration or refund. Entire-footprint root eligibility remains false while any cover or residue remains; exhausting work does not prove suitable soil. No unattended work, regrowth suppression, planting, food, moisture/fertility improvement or reward. Study and surface changes are separate.

candidates.function: Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Completed plots retain the real reserved root while existing environmental ageing runs. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. Other people can observe the actual plot; execution requires personal study.

candidates.function: Place owned moss, inspect the resulting arrangement or perform a real ground-supported contact/rest trial.
candidates.costs: Quote: retrieve this ability through the free control abilities query; reading these exact terms takes no world round. Begin requires inputStackId, quantity 0.1–2 in tenths, x/y and radius 0.1–0.5, two actual rounds at 1 energy each. Study costs two rounds at 0.2 energy. Inspect requires arrangementId, one round/0.2 energy. Rest-trial requires arrangementId and actual contact position, one baseline rest round, with existing mental/facility factors and cap40. Resume/cancel use exact processId. Additional placement on an owned unlocked arrangement repeats the same costs and exact footprint.
candidates.effects: First step places actual reserved moss at the site; second spreads actual tenths within the nominated radius, without mass-to-volume or coverage inference. Placed ground material is recoverable with recover(arrangementId), one round/0.5 energy for actual reachable surviving portions; this scoped pickup supports tenths that baseline whole-unit pickup cannot. Recovery removes material from the arrangement. Cancel/death preserve placed material and paid work; no refund or automatic labor. Rest measures real geometric contact and at most0.02 lateral displacement of contacted loose material inside the footprint; no inferred load strength, thickness, comfort, durability or recovery bonus. Usability remains inconclusive. Personal findings are not publicly shared. No reward, regeneration, binding, tool or stock grant.

candidates.function: Record a planted-root baseline, observe, or physically uncover and cover an existing specimen while retaining actual progress and private evidence.
candidates.costs: Begin/observe: one round and 0.2 energy. Inspect: two paid work rounds, one energy each, no consumed root or tools. Only the creator may handle a plot; anyone may observe reachable public state. Provide target plot ID; resume/cancel can use exact personal processId.
candidates.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. Interruption retains exposure and paid work; resume completes outstanding work only. Cancel/death releases the lock without automatically covering or refunding effort. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended. Repeated unchanged observations and the 30-round checkpoint create no reward. No inferred germination, tending benefit, harvested food or biomass is supplied. Relevant dated physical changes may use the single existing grounded-understanding rule. Records remain personal until actual communication.
